SAST Finding

**Non-literal regular expression usage leading to ReDoS vulnerability** (CWE-185)

False positive.

The interpolated value is escaped with the shared `escapeRegExp` helper, so no regex
metacharacters can be injected. The resulting pattern `^\s*<literal>\s*$` contains no nested or
overlapping quantifiers, which is what ReDoS requires. The value is also trimmed, so the literal
cannot begin or end with whitespace and each `\s*` has exactly one possible match — the pattern
is linear with no backtracking.

`typeOrSymbol` is a Collibra asset type name that comes from a Playwright test fixture or a
hardcoded string in a test file. This is E2E test code: it never processes user- or
network-supplied input, and the match target is the text of a single grid cell.

The same `new RegExp(... escapeRegExp(...) ...)` construction is already used on main in
createLifecycleTrackerComponent.ts, createDmHorizontalFiltersSettingsPage.ts (also with the `i`
flag), createDmSettingsFeaturedPage.ts and create-row-filters.page.ts, so this is not a new
pattern introduced by this PR.

This flips the AssetType predicate from substring (hasText) to anchored full-text. Any caller passing a prefix of the rendered label silently goes from matching to matching nothing.

It backs two exported helpers (getRowByModelNameAndType, getRowByModelFullNameAndType), which fan out via createDomainPage.clickAssetLinkByNameAndType, assetValidationHelper.ts:87 and modelVerificationHelper.ts:36 to ~90 references across 12 integration suites (bedrock, anthropic, dataplex, sagemaker, databricks, snowflake, vertex, thoughtspot, openai, sap-ai, mlflow, azure).

Could you please check that other test suites are not affected?

Checked. Of 83 distinct type values reaching the predicate, only 6 are a prefix of another type,
so those are the only places semantics change:

- 'AI Agent' -> 'AI Agent Tool'/'AI Agent Version' (bedrock, anthropic, databricks, snowflake,
  vertex): affected, and this is the bug being fixed. Cortex was opening the AI Agent Version
  asset because both are named "Agent for automated tests", so the substring match made the row
  ambiguous and .first() picked the wrong one.
- 'Database' -> 'Database View' (databricks, vertex): affected. Distinct types, so anchored is
  correct.
- 'Sigma Workbook', 'F', 'DIR': not affected. Sigma reaches the predicate in 0 files; 'F'/'DIR'
  only appear in commented-out fixture lines (gcs:274, adls:237).
- 'ThoughtSpot Answer': not affected. The only thoughtspot file reaching the predicate
  (thoughtspotTechnicalLineageSync.test.ts:246) passes the long form.

Also: sigma, adls, gcs, s3, fabric and signavio reach the predicate in 0 files.

It's an anchored regex with 'i' rather than { exact: true } because exact matching is
case-sensitive and broke SageMaker — fixtures say 'AWS SageMaker ...', the product renders
'AWS Sagemaker ...'.

Green: sagemaker (x2), cortex, vertex, azure #1, databricks-outbound. Not yet run: bedrock,
anthropic, dataplex, databricks-ai, snowflake-listings, mlflow, thoughtspot-lineage, openai,
sap-ai — happy to gate those on CI, or run specific ones if you'd prefer.

There's no wait for the new row to mount between this Add click and the .last() lookups on lines 48/50. Playwright's auto-waiting doesn't help: the previous row's input is already visible, enabled and editable, so .last() resolves to it and the fill succeeds against the wrong element instead of retrying.

This fires in the test's own second step (databricksOutboundRegisterFromIntegrationsPage.test.ts:176-179): attributeToTag already holds one row, and if React hasn't committed row 2 yet, govern_tag overwrites regular_tag and one row is saved instead of two.

playwrightBaseConfig.ts:94 sets actionTimeout: isCI ? SECS_30 : SECS_5. Pinning the action to SECS_10 here overrides that in both directions: 30s → 10s on CI (the 30s is deliberate slack for loaded runners) and 5s → 10s locally.

Agreed, removed. The action no longer passes a timeout, so playwrightBaseConfig's actionTimeout
applies and CI keeps its 30s slack. It was bounding the rare detached-row case, which isn't worth
overriding project config for — the visibility probe already removes the expensive miss path.
